notes.title: Update 17.10.20
notes.notes:
１、Remove the joke in "About".
２、English returned.
３、Fixed a bug where AI could move before a game start.
４、Fixed a bug where you couldn't quit by pressing "Exit".
５、Now you can subscribe a normal AI engine from workshop.
６、Added auto rotate camera function in local mode.
As the only developer of this game, my negligence brought quite a lot bugs upon release. I apologize for that! Thanks for your support!
